plan.summary:
Refresh now rejects malformed refresh tokens before calling the server.

- `refresh` throws `Malformed refresh token` when the token does not match `/^[\w-]{20,}$/`.
- `maskToken` moves lower in `src/auth/tokens.ts`. Its body is unchanged.
plan.riskRationale: The change touches the auth token refresh path. A new regex check can reject tokens the server would accept. The change is small.
plan.storyArc: The purpose is to fail early on bad refresh tokens, so the server is not called with them. The `maskToken` move is only reordering and needs no review.

noise.reason: Removes `maskToken` from the top of the file. hunk-1 adds it back with the same body, so this is code moved without change.

topics.title: Reject malformed refresh tokens before server call
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `refresh` check before it calls `fetchTokens`, and which tokens does it reject? Verify the regex `/^[\w-]{20,}$/` and that `maskToken` is only moved, with its body unchanged.
